Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Intensive Sign Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Intensive Sign Reading, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How are characters and events in a text related to real life? 2. Why is summary writing an important reading skill?
